name: sada
description: صدى — مدير محتوى ذكي على Cloudflare

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run cycles && npm run contrast && npm run tokens && npm run classes && npm run rtl && npm run dead && npm run columns && npm run test
scripts.migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply sada-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply sada --env production --remote
scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply sada-staging --env staging --local
scripts.render: tsx scripts/render_panel.ts /tmp/panel.html && tsx scripts/render_screens.ts && tsx scripts/render_legal.ts /tmp/privacy.html /privacy
scripts.audit: npm run render && node scripts/audit_design.mjs /tmp/panel.html /tmp/panel-first.html /tmp/screen-tasks.html /tmp/screen-wizard.html /tmp/screen-report.html /tmp/screen-linkedin.html /tmp/screen-refused.html /tmp/screen-journey.html /tmp/screen-spread.html /tmp/screen-login.html /tmp/screen-2fa.html /tmp/privacy.html && node scripts/audit_scale.mjs /tmp/panel.html /tmp/panel-first.html /tmp/screen-tasks.html /tmp/screen-wizard.html /tmp/screen-report.html /tmp/screen-linkedin.html /tmp/screen-refused.html /tmp/screen-journey.html /tmp/screen-spread.html /tmp/screen-login.html /tmp/screen-2fa.html /tmp/privacy.html && npm run mobile && npm run print && npm run csp && npm run links
